title: Generated in-memory DBCOLOR typed source capture
scope: Retain the complete typed DRW_DbColor callback by import generation and source handle under a bounded byte and record budget, atomically with the appearance map used to reconcile earlier entities.

behavior: Each accepted DBCOLOR callback stores its complete typed source record, including common ownership/reactor/extension metadata and the retained color-book fields, keyed by import generation and handle.
The typed record is estimated before copying and bounded by the DBCOLOR record and retained-byte limits.
Typed source and appearance insertion are rolled back together if either insertion fails; duplicate identities fail closed without overwriting accepted values.
The adapter test verifies preserved typed fields, generation separation, appearance precedence, and duplicate refusal.

control.profile: Locally authored in-memory AC1027 callback profile; no external drawing input.
control.fixtureDisposition: No DWG/DXF fixture was created or added.

validation.diffCheck: git diff --check passed; receipt parsed as valid JSON

limitations: The callback control is generated and in-memory; it does not provide physical DWG producer evidence.
Typed retention does not establish the DBCOLOR source frame field span, ACAD_COLOR owner/entry closure, DXF output equivalence, or fresh readback.
nextReadyPacket: Prove the source DBCOLOR frame against an independent physical source profile, then admit only the exact ACAD_COLOR dictionary and typed DBCOLOR output graph whose owner, entry, field, and fresh-readback evidence closes.
